principles: Gates consume mechanically trustworthy framework-written facts, never self-declared caller identity
Reviewer independent verification is review policy and must never block DONE
Closeout anti-thrash guarantees keep their teeth: redundant closeout-side executions and contradictory records still fail fast
Smallest semantic change that removes the permanent deadlock; root-cause eviction fix deferred to a follow-up
drivers: B-956f closing was permanently poisoned and needed a ceremony DEV->REVIEW bounce that contradicts the reviewer mandate
EXP-001: caller identity (main agent vs subagent, reviewer vs closeout CLI invocation) is not mechanically distinguishable
Single-slot receipt eviction in test-evidence.json makes forced re-execution of an already-executed identity routine, not exceptional
The same derivation already models observable-vs-blocking via reviewerReattestations vs postTestReviewerReattestations with the TEST-entry boundary

options.name: A-phase-anchored-split
pros: Uses only framework-written facts (facts.testEntryAt, event timestamps) already collected
Mirrors the proven reviewerReattestations/postTestReviewerReattestations pattern in the same function
No event schema change, no new trust surface, surgical diff
Keeps blocking teeth exactly where the closeout path owns the state machine (at or after TEST entry)
cons: Pre-TEST redundant executions become observable-only, slightly weakening waste detection
Does not fix the receipt-eviction root cause; wasteful re-executions still happen

options.name: B-writer-attribution-field
pros: Directly expresses closeout-vs-reviewer intent per event
cons: Attribution is self-declared by the caller; EXP-001 proved callers are not mechanically distinguishable, so the field is forgeable and cannot gate
Requires event schema change plus backfill/compat handling for historical events

options.name: C-n-per-lane-allowance
cons: Lane identity is not recorded on validation_terminal events, so per-lane counting is not implementable from durable facts
An arbitrary N weakens the invariant globally including the closeout path

options.name: D-multi-slot-receipt-store
pros: Fixes the eviction root cause: reuse would succeed per identity and forced re-executions disappear
cons: test-evidence.json is consumed by DONE gate, freshness classification, drift handling, refresh_stale and dashboards; wide blast radius
Does not by itself unblock the invariant when a reviewer intentionally re-executes; still needs counting semantics decided

rationale: Option A removes the deadlock using only framework-written facts already flowing through the derivation, mirrors an established observable-vs-blocking precedent in the very same function, changes no schemas, and preserves the closeout anti-thrash guarantee where the closeout path is the only legitimate executor (at or after TEST entry). Option B is forgeable per EXP-001, option C is not implementable from durable facts, and option D is the correct follow-up root-cause fix but has a blast radius disproportionate to unblocking DONE; A plus a follow-up story for D is the safest sequencing.

preMortem.scenario: A reviewer executes the suite during TEST before done_prepare runs, consuming the one allowed post-TEST execution for its group
preMortem.trigger: Post-TEST reviewer validate on an evicted receipt executes instead of reusing
preMortem.consequence: done_prepare validate then either reuses (PASS, correct) or re-executes (blocked with unchangedSuiteExecutions=1), so the gate stays mechanically sound but the block message may confuse the operator
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the blocked output rendering both counters so the operator sees reviewWindowSuiteExecutions vs blocking count; post-TEST reviewer re-attestation via review passes is already independently blocking

preMortem.scenario: Strict convergence-line regexes in sibling smokes silently drift from the new render format
preMortem.trigger: Adding reviewWindowSuiteExecutions to the rendered convergence line
preMortem.consequence: done-prepare-merge-rerun, auto-closeout, closure-heartbeat smokes fail or, worse, stop matching and stop asserting
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-003 enumerates every regex via rg 'convergence: metadataRollbacks=' and updates them; lattice validate runs all listed smokes

preMortem.scenario: donePrepareJsonResult transcript parser falls out of sync and JSON consumers read absent convergence
preMortem.trigger: Render line changes while the parse regex at done-prepare.ts:1077 keeps the old shape
preMortem.consequence: JSON output silently loses the convergence block, breaking downstream telemetry
preMortem.mitigation: Update the parse regex in the same commit and extend the existing flow-stability donePrepareJsonResult assertion to the new line shape

preMortem.scenario: Pre-TEST churn loops (DEV->REVIEW thrash re-executing the suite) are no longer blocked by this invariant
preMortem.trigger: Reclassifying pre-TEST duplicates as observable telemetry
preMortem.consequence: A pathological loop could burn suite executions without tripping this particular assert
preMortem.mitigation: metadataRollbacks still blocks REVIEW/TEST->DEV rollbacks on unchanged material, the convergence breaker consumes repeated lifecycle operations independently, and the new telemetry field keeps the redundancy visible in every PASS transcript
